This program is not turning thoughts into sound, or reading thoughts at all. It is not as if the specific neural patterns recorded in this epileptics objectively translate to numerals.

What is happening is they are recording the acoustics of the sounds themselves as the speakers says them and correlating those to a pattern of neural waves in the brain at the time of that audio stimulus.

This is then used to create a "lexicon" for the computer. When it is programmed to reproduce the neural pattern, it then knows what sound to make.

There is a lot of sensational journalism that gets written on these kinds of subjects. But we don't know what thought is yet. We know there is a concomitant neural event that accompanies thought, but nothing about how consciousness actually arises from it, or what the substrate of thought is. Computers cannot read our thoughts.

They are studying the concomitant physical phenomena (neural patterns firing) that are occurring when an auditory stimulus is given. The acoustic data for that sound are being mapped to various neural patterns. When that neural pattern is triggered in the program, it is reproducing the sound based on how the acoustic data were mapped to it.
